hero_intro: GDUXI is a brand and digital design studio. We design the mark and the experience together, so your logo, your website and your app feel like one piece.
hero_joiner: one brand, flowing from mark to screen
founders_intro: Equal partners with complementary skills. Navita leads the experience, Paramdeep leads the identity, and every project gets both of us.

stats.label: industries: travel, education, retail, hospitality, finance

services_title: Three ways to work with us
services_intro: Hire either founder for their speciality, or both of us for the whole journey: a brand and a digital product designed as one system.
work_intro: Two built together from mark to screen, plus identity and digital projects.
why_title: Your brand shouldn't change at the browser.
why_intro: Most small businesses hire a logo designer, then a web designer, and spend months making the two agree. We start them together.

why_points.title: One idea, every touchpoint
why_points.body: The mark, the colours and the interface come from the same thinking, so customers recognise you on a flyer, a phone and a checkout page.

why_points.title: Research meets craft
why_points.body: User research tells us what people need. Identity design makes it memorable. You get evidence and personality.

why_points.title: Fewer handoffs, faster launch
why_points.body: No briefing a second agency, no rebuilding the logo for screens. One team, one timeline, one invoice.

process_intro: Clear milestones, one shared timeline, and you always know who is leading each stage.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: A kickoff call, stakeholder chats and quick user interviews. We agree on the problem before we draw anything.

steps.title: Identity
steps.body: Mood boards, sketches and two or three mark directions, refined into a logo and a brand guide.

steps.title: Experience
steps.body: Information architecture, wireframes and hi-fi UI built on the new brand, then tested with real users.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Final files, a working prototype or site, and a launch kit for socials and print.

cta_title:

cta_body: Tell us about your project. You'll hear back from both of us within two business days.
